title: Complete Dynamics SL Migration to Business Central

facts.text: Select Complete migration with SUPER permission set, then on Cloud Ready Checklist page turn on the confirmation switch.
Select Disable Cloud Migration and confirm with Yes to end the migration.
Integration runtime remains installed after completing cloud migration; cloud registration auto-cleans if unused for weeks.
Set up users by creating Microsoft 365 accounts with Business Central licenses for each user.
Create Business Central accounts associated with Microsoft 365 email and assign proper permissions to data.
Dynamics SL user accounts and permissions are not migrated to Business Central online.
